name: prohor-assets
description: Minimal Vite/esbuild build step for public/assets/css/app.css and public/assets/js/app.js. No framework, no imports — this only bundles/minifies the two existing hand-written files into public/assets/dist/. The app itself stays zero-Composer-package PHP with vanilla JS; this is a build-tooling upgrade, not a framework adoption.
